title: A Survey of Bugs in AI-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2512.05239v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI coding systems are increasingly used to help developers write code at scale, improving software development efficiency and boosting productivity. While these models and agents have shown strong performance, concerns persist regarding the quality of the AI-generated code. Although prior work has reported a range of quality issues associated with AI-generated code, these findings remain scattered and lack a systematic synthesis. A comprehensive review is lacking that demonstrates the bug types, patterns, distribution, their correlation with specific AI coding systems, and the remediation strategies proposed to address them. To fill this gap, we conduct a systematic literature review of existing studies on AI-generated code to develop a comprehensive understanding of bugs in the generated code and provide a foundation for future improvements in AI-assisted coding. Our results show that bugs are widespread in AI-generated code,

translated_title: AI生成代码中的缺陷综述
translated_abstract: AI编程系统正日益被用于帮助开发者大规模编写代码，从而提升软件开发效率并提高生产力。尽管这些模型和智能体已展现出强大的性能，但人们对其生成代码的质量仍存有担忧。虽然已有研究报道了AI生成代码的一系列质量问题，但这些发现仍然零散，缺乏系统性的归纳整理。目前尚缺乏一项全面的综述来展示缺陷的类型、模式、分布、其与特定AI编程系统的关联，以及针对这些问题所提出的修复策略。为填补这一空白，我们对现有的AI生成代码相关研究开展了系统性文献综述，以全面理解生成代码中的缺陷，并为未来AI辅助编程的改进奠定基础。我们的结果表明，缺陷在AI生成的代码中普遍存在。
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，首次全面梳理了AI生成代码中缺陷的类型、模式、分布及其与特定AI编程系统的关联和相应的修复策略，揭示了缺陷在AI生成代码中的普遍性。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a systematic literature review that comprehensively synthesizes the types, patterns, and distribution of bugs in AI-generated code, their correlation with specific AI coding systems, and remediation strategies, revealing that bugs are widespread in AI-generated code.
